exit 0
--- stdout
Find and clear expired review leases on tasks in reviewing status.
When a Code Reviewer crashes mid-review, reviewing_by and review_lease_expires
remain set. This command clears expired claims so other reviewers can claim the task.
Typically called by:
- Code Reviewer supervisor on startup
- Periodically by cron or monitoring
- TUI dashboard (though tui shouldn't mutate state by default)
Reports the number of claims cleared and logs each cleanup action.
Usage:
liza clear-stale-review-claims [flags]
Flags:
-h, --help help for clear-stale-review-claims
--json output result as structured JSON
Global Flags:
--check-update check for a Liza update before running
-C, --project-root string Liza project root for state commands
--update-channel string update check channel: stable or main (default "stable")
-v, --verbose verbose output
--- stderr
